hypotheses.htf_trend_pullback: H4 EMA20 above/below EMA50 with EMA50 slope over three bars; aligned H1 EMA20/50, previous H1 close pulls back across EMA20, current directional >=50%-body candle reclaims EMA20 and breaks previous high/low by 0.3 pip.
hypotheses.htf_range_retest: Same H4 trend; previous H1 closes beyond the prior 20-bar range by 0.3 pip; current H1 retests that boundary and closes outside it with a directional >=50%-body candle. Range excludes breakout and confirmation bars.

plan.baseline: Common reference: original USDCHF M30/M1 liquidity model applied separately to each pair with identical risk settings; not the previously configured EURUSD/GBPUSD live branches.
plan.ema_context: Fixed 150 closed H1/H4 bars (3*EMA50); no forming candles; H4 must close by H1 decision.
plan.risk_unchanged: 0.1% planned risk, 20-pip initial stop, 0.05 maximum lot, 2R initial TP, original 1R/1R trailing, same daily loss/exposure/valuation guards, one position per symbol, one-hour cooldown and original entry sessions/spread cap. No risk override, averaging or stop widening.
plan.fixed_selection: Per pair, highest net sum over first six TRAINING windows only; positive/improved sum vs common baseline, >=4 windows with >=20 trades, DD sum<=1.25 baseline; otherwise baseline. No parameter tuning.
plan.adaptive_selection: Per pair and window: highest own prior-training net; >=20 trades, positive/improved vs baseline, DD<=1.25 baseline. Otherwise baseline.
plan.promotion: Fixed training-nominated model must improve aggregate and positive confirmation net, retain >=20 confirmation trades, aggregate/confirmation DD<=1.25 baseline, and positive/not-worse stressed confirmation net. All gates mandatory.
plan.comparison: Replay all nine declared pair/model combinations, rank descriptively by net. Do not sum independent accounts or use test winners to amend frozen choices.
limitations: These dates and prior strategies were examined before. Outcomes for these two new models are evaluated after registration; the historical period is not genuinely untouched future data.

Three independently simulated EUR 10,000 accounts per model; no combined portfolio/correlation or concurrent cross-symbol daily/exposure simulation. Returns cannot be added into a single-account return.
Folds start flat monthly; no compounding. Training windows overlap; their sums are selection diagnostics. Drawdown is realized cash-flow drawdown, not intratrade equity drawdown.

Commission and slippage are assumptions; historical symbol valuation is constant. Swap/overnight financing, latency and full tick paths are not modeled. Overnight-trade counts are disclosed; net is after modeled execution costs, not every possible broker charge.
Monthly forced closes limit holding duration. Multiple comparisons and prior history reuse limit inference; no model is approved for real-money trading by descriptive profit alone.
plan.history_access: EURUSD/GBPUSD extended read-only from an already-running connected MT5 terminal with AutoTrading disabled; USDCHF uses the prior read-only snapshot. No bot/order operations.
